findings: The provided page describes registering/logging in, activating MCP, obtaining the MCP service address and key, then configuring clients.
Official Codex instructions require Account-SK and Authorization Bearer.
Official Claude Desktop instructions use a key query parameter.
Official Accio application-authorization menu still leads to manual key-bearing MCP URL configuration; this is not evidence of a delegated OAuth protocol.
conclusion: Publicly documented key-based access is confirmed. OAuth or equivalent delegated account authorization for Yijie is unconfirmed, not proven nonexistent.
